descriptor.name: projects/nebula-arena-ga-20261109/metricDescriptors/run.googleapis.com/container/instance_count
descriptor.description: Number of container instances that exist, broken down by state.

descriptor.name: projects/nebula-arena-ga-20261109/metricDescriptors/run.googleapis.com/container/max_request_concurrencies
descriptor.description: Distribution of the maximum number of concurrent requests being served by each container instance over a minute. Filter by 'state' = 'active' only get the concurrency of active container instances.

descriptor.name: projects/nebula-arena-ga-20261109/metricDescriptors/run.googleapis.com/container/startup_latencies
descriptor.description: Distribution of time spent starting a new container instance in milliseconds.

descriptor.name: projects/nebula-arena-ga-20261109/metricDescriptors/run.googleapis.com/request_latencies

labels.description: Response code class of a request.

descriptor.description: Distribution of request latency in milliseconds reaching the revision. Latency is measured from when the request reaches the running container to when it exits. Notably, it does not include container startup latency.

descriptor.name: projects/nebula-arena-ga-20261109/metricDescriptors/run.googleapis.com/request_count

labels.description: Response code class of a request.

descriptor.description: Number of requests reaching the revision. Excludes requests that are not reaching your container instances (for example, unauthorized requests or when maximum number of instances is reached). Captured at the end of the request lifecycle.

descriptor.name: projects/nebula-arena-ga-20261109/metricDescriptors/run.googleapis.com/container/billable_instance_time
descriptor.description: Billable time aggregated across all container instances. For a given container instance, billable time occurs when the container instance is starting or at least one request is being processed. Billable time is rounded up to the nearest 100 milliseconds. Examples: If a revision with 2 container instances has been continuously serving traffic in the last minute, the value is 2s/s with the default "rate" aligner. If a single request lasting 30ms was received by a revision in the past minute, it is rounded up to 100ms and averaged to 1.7ms/s over the minute with the default "rate" aligner.
